title: Streaming an Implicit 3D Tiles Tileset
description: Streams an implicit 3D Tiles tileset with TilesetStreamer. The tree is described by binary .subtree availability files and Morton-indexed coordinates; the streamer fetches subtrees on demand as the camera descends, derives each tile's bounding volume by box subdivision, frustum-culls tiles outside the view, and loads/unloads per-tile SceneModels.
